newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas called lower ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas called lower ahead of weekend.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natural gas futures were expected to open lower Friday as a questionable rally ran out of steam ahead of the weekend, industry sources said.
June over-the-counter trade ranged from $2.22-2.23 after settling Thursday at $2.243 per million British thermal units.

"You've achieved all your objectives. Most traders aren't willing to take the risk over a weekend after they've made all that money," one trader said, noting Henry Hub cash prices were talked steady at $2.19 per mmBtu.
On ACCESS, June last traded 1.1 cents higher at $2.254.
Technical traders pegged next resistance in June at $2.33 and then at the $2.385 contract high. Support was seen at $2.17 and then at $2.05 and along the up trendline at $2.01.
In Thursday's cash, Gulf Coast swing prices firmed a couple of cents to the mid-teens. Midcon pipes were up six cents to $2.00-2.05. New York city gate gas also gained five cents to the mid-$2.40s.

Cooler temperatures are forecast for the weekend throughout most of the U.S. before returning to seasonable levels early next week in the central U.S. Warmer-than-normal weather is expected to continue throughout most of the Southwest, Weather Services Corp said.
